title: When Should Enterprise Policy Decisions Be Learned, and When Should They Be Reasoned?
abstract: arXiv:2610.17643v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An enterprise agent that answers under a written policy must choose an action before it says anything: answer, ask for a missing fact, ask for confirmation, call one or several tools, escalate, or refuse. Holding one 27B Korean enterprise model fixed, we vary whether the decision is a generated JSON object or a single constrained token, and whether the model may reason first.   On 2800 in-distribution items we did not detect an accuracy difference between the two deployed paths (93.46% vs 94.14%), while they differ about tenfold in restart stability (3.00% of actions flip vs 0.29%); they also differ in reasoning, so this is an operational comparison.   On a sealed benchmark of 300 items whose labels come from a hidden executable policy, reasoning is worth +17.3 points [+12.3, +23.0] on exact action. translated_title: 企业政策决策何时应该通过学习获得，何时应该通过推理完成？
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.17643v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：一个在书面政策约束下回答问题的企业智能体必须在开口作答之前先选择一个动作：直接回答、询问缺失的事实、请求确认、调用一个或多个工具、上报升级，或拒绝。在保持一个27B参数的韩语企业模型不变的情况下，我们改变了决策的产出形式（是生成一个JSON对象还是输出单个受约束的token），以及模型是否可以先进行推理。在2800个分布内样本上，我们没有检测到两条已部署路径之间的准确率差异（93.46% vs 94.14%），但两者在重启稳定性上相差约十倍（动作翻转比例3.00% vs 0.29%）；同时两者在推理方面也存在差异，因此这是一项面向运营层面的比较。在一个包含300个样本、标签来自隐藏可执行策略的密封基准测试上，先推理在精确动作匹配上带来+17.3分的提升 [+12.3, +23.0]。在关闭推理的情况下，格式差异为0.0分 [-4.3, +4.0]，这意味着未能检测到任一接口的优势，而非证明了两者等价。
tldr: 该研究在固定27B企业模型下系统比较了决策格式（JSON对象 vs 单个约束token）与是否先推理，发现分布内数据上两种格式准确率相当但单token格式重启稳定性高约十倍，而在面对隐藏可执行策略的密封基准时先推理可带来+17.3分的显著增益，从而回答了企业政策决策何时应“学习”、何时应“推理”的问题。
en_tdlr: Holding a 27B enterprise model fixed, this study shows that in-distribution policy decisions need not be reasoned—JSON and single-token formats match in accuracy while the single-token format is tenfold more stable—but explicit reasoning yields a +17.3-point gain when generalizing to a sealed benchmark labeled by hidden executable policies.
